purpose: Pinned frozen CLIP image encoder reference shared by ML feature extraction (#20) and the Backend model loader (#24/#37).

preprocessing.before_processor: load_image_rgb: EXIF transpose, alpha on white, 8-bit RGB
preprocessing.processor: CLIPImageProcessor defaults from pinned preprocessor_config.json (resize shortest side 224, center crop 224, CLIP mean/std)

embedding.dim_source: measured by scripts/smoke_clip.py; must equal model.config.projection_dim

weights_usage_note: OpenAI CLIP weights are published for research use; the model card states deployment use cases are out of scope without in-domain evaluation. This project uses them frozen, locally, for a course research demo only. Weights are never committed (see .gitignore).
